title: Delivery repair interrupts speculative planning safely

rubric.text: Prioritizes same-owner CI repair only after acknowledged quiescence and reconciled publication. Retains planner owner/draft/claim and resumes with 18 active minutes and unchanged attempts after 40 yielded minutes; ambiguous publication does not free capacity or invite duplicate publication.
Uses four as the strict active-agent ceiling and four as slot limit, counts planner/descendants, can use two remaining active agents, and never treats ranked candidates as grants.

Allows only plan-proven disjoint slices; serializes the canonical shared path/resource and older-first integration boundary, retains exclusive writers and renewed final-head review, and delays whole tickets for dependencies/inseparable or uncertain seams. When older integration is authority/decision-paused, uses verified preservation pause to release younger capacity only after reconciled publication and quiescence, preserves claim/owner/artifacts, and resumes in a free slot only after verified older integration and lease revalidation. Unknown publication retains blocked capacity; runnable older integration retains the occupied younger slot; a grant alone is not completion.

Uses targeted fresh occupied-ticket reads for unchanged CI, rehydrates only changed/unverified records, records full-refresh/invalidation reasons, and requires complete valid state at merge/recovery/selection/finish or after partial reads without waiving fresh write authority.

Reports 10 planning, 10 implementation and 4 wait minutes with overlap within 15 wall minutes, persists interval identities, and diagnoses repeated cycles with evidence and one bounded next action rather than invented savings or reset budgets.
